agents.label: wave1-synthesize
agents.task: Cross-plan synthesis (review plan steps 1, 3, 4, 6). Read docs/workflow/tasks/original-architecture.md plus all 9 refined sub-plans: (a) build the traceability matrix (every original requirement -> exactly one owning sub-plan; flag orphans and double-owners, resolving by editing the matrix notes, not the sub-plans); (b) seam check on adjacent plans (query->filters->scoring->rerank, rerank<->federated, filters<->AI-advisory, storage<->crawler<->custom-index) — shared boundaries must live in exactly one plan; (c) order check — no plan may require a later-numbered plan's output to validate (reorder tasks_status rows if violated); (d) consistency — uniform naming, no contradictory config shapes or interface assumptions. Write the matrix, refinements-applied summary, and order verdict into the Review notes section of the review plan file; update tasks_status rows 8-15 and 17 notes to match. Doc edits only.
agents.done: Review notes section filled with trace matrix, seam/order/consistency verdicts; tasks_status rows match refined scopes; summary names every orphan, double-owner, and order change (or states none found).

integrate.label: wave2-audit
integrate.owns: verification only; may fix typos and broken cross-links in the 9 sub-plans and review plan, nothing else
integrate.task: Final audit of the review (review plan Validation). Re-read all 9 refined sub-plans plus the filled Review notes end-to-end: verify each plan meets the quality bar (falsifiable goal, executable steps, exact validation, non-goals), the trace matrix covers every original requirement exactly once, scalability findings exist per plan, and tasks_status matches. Report pass/fail per validation item with the file+section evidencing each pass. Fix only typos and broken links; substantive gaps go in the report as unresolved, not silent fixes.
integrate.done: Validation checklist reported with evidence per item; any remaining gaps named explicitly with the exact file and section.
